card.name: Arrhythmias needing cardioversion or pacing
card.fires_on: The word right after a ventricular arrhythmia (VT, fibrillation) where the text goes on to name an electrical treatment, such as 'requiring' before cardioversion or defibrillation. It also fires inside or just before pacemaker, pacing or electrical conversion terms.
